title: Prodromal Alpha-Synuclein Screening in Parkinson’s Disease Study
summary: The PASS-PD study is set out to screen individuals from the general population with an increased risk for the development of Parkinson's Disease (PD) and to investigate this highly enriched cohort longitudinally for ten years. A special focus is placed on implementation of ethical standards for early risk disclosure in PD.
conditions: Primary Parkinson's syndrome with no or minimal impairment: No fluctuation in effect

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
(I) Capacity for consent (in case of doubt verified by two independent neurologists), (II) written informed consent, (III) age  ≥ 50 years
Exclusion criteria:
(I) Presence of clinical PD at the time of study inclusion, (II) other significant neurologic diseases affecting the central nervous system (e.g. Multiple sclerosis), (III) other significant diseases e.g. orthopaedic diseases affecting quantitative motor assessment; (IV) in case of participation in the lumbal puncture substudy: contraindications for the performance of lumbal puncture (bleeding tendency, intake of anticoagulants)
